title: Skincare Brand Hyaluronic Acid Serum for Face, Hydrating Face Serum
item_highlights: Hyaluronic acid and vitamin B5, moisturizing serum for face with aloe vera, for dry skin, lightweight and dewy
bullets: PLUMP, DEWY-LOOKING SKIN: This hyaluronic acid serum for dry skin draws moisture to the surface so your face looks smooth, bouncy and fresh. Hyaluronic Acid (Sodium Hyaluronate) is the hero of the formula, leaving skin feeling comfortable from the first drop.

HYDRATION IN LAYERS: Two forms of hyaluronic acid work with Pro-Vitamin B5 (Panthenol) to keep skin feeling soft and supple, while Vitamin E (Tocopherol) helps support its appearance against daily environmental stressors.

WATER-LIGHT GEL TEXTURE: Clear, silky and never sticky, this B5 serum sinks in within seconds and sits well under moisturizer, sunscreen and makeup. Aloe Vera and Green Tea Extract add a calm, refreshed look.

MADE FOR THIRSTY SKIN: Ideal for dry, normal and combination skin that feels tight or looks dull. Gentle enough for daily use and an easy first serum if you are new to skincare. Helps reduce the look of fine lines caused by dryness.

SIMPLE ROUTINE, HONEST CARE: Apply 3-4 drops to clean, damp skin morning and evening, then follow with moisturizer. Vegan and cruelty free, made to keep ingredient-led skincare affordable for everyone.
